summary: Defines the textual conventions and the general group of MIB objects for IPv6. It is the base of a series of IPv6 MIB documents. It is now historic and was replaced by RFC 4293 and RFC 8096.

eli5.summary: These are the first dials in a set for watching IPv6 behavior in a network. Newer documents replaced them.

questions: what is the ipv6 mib general group
